dropped.item: "I found myself doing" became "I did", which loses the sense of acting on autopilot or habit without deliberate intent

changed.item: "I hadn't given much thought to how I would actually leave the room" became "I never thought about how I would actually leave the room". The edit hardens 'little thought' into 'no thought at all'.
"trying to figure out how to teach again" became "working out how to teach again". The original implies an attempt with an uncertain outcome; the edit implies more successful resolution.
